subtitle: Roles, responsibilities, and the impact delivered along the way.

experiences.title: Financial Analyst
experiences.description:
Architected Financial Modeling and valuation models in Advanced Excel, VBA, and SQL for business combinations and stock-based compensation, enhancing forecast accuracy and audit-ready financial reporting.
Developed detailed accounting memoranda for revenue recognition, equity transactions, and acquisition-related analyses by interpreting GAAP guidance and financial data, enabling consistent regulatory compliance and accelerating audit review cycles by 25%.
Evaluated internal control frameworks across revenue, equity, and financial reporting processes through risk assessments and control testing, identifying remediation opportunities that strengthened governance and reduced compliance risks by 20%.
Optimized executive financial reporting by analyzing large financial datasets with Excel, Power BI, and Python, delivering KPI dashboards, variance analysis, and actionable business insights that improved strategic decision-making and reporting efficiency by 30%.
Supported financial system implementation and reporting enhancements by validating financial data and developing Power BI and Tableau dashboards to monitor KPIs, trends, and variance analysis, improving management reporting and decision-making.
Streamlined financial documentation and process workflows by standardizing control narratives, process flowcharts, and supporting evidence using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and internal reporting tools, decreasing audit preparation time by 35% while enhancing process consistency.
